answer: A payout is split thus 35% arrives at settlement and the rest over 9 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The lotus schedule is applied in spiral and zenith shows each instalment. Anyone thus cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4133 identities would post 3631 proofs and burn roughly 34 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
